native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?

### 最终自然语言假设（用于提交，英文）
**"Diversity in Pottery Form collapses in the 18th century BCE (spanning 1800–1700 BC; equivalently CE −1800 to −1700, calBP 3750 to 3650), and within that same century Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneously. sub_hypo.context: Archaeological pottery records during the designated 18th-century BCE window, 1800–1700 BC (CE −1800 to −1700; calBP 3750 to 3650), with persistence for approximately 12 centuries from 1700 BC onward. Dataset group labels change from LN at 1800 BC to OBA at 1700 BC. Under the no-year-zero century convention, 1700 BC itself begins the 17th century BCE.
sub_hypo.relations: Simultaneous opposite changes: Pottery Form Z falls from +0.74 to its floor of −1.13 (Δ ≈ −1.87), while Pottery Decoration Z rises from −0.48 to +0.97 (Δ ≈ +1.45). This is the only scanned 100-year window meeting both a form decline of at least 1.0 and a decoration increase of at least 0.5 Z units. Thereafter, form remains −1.13 while decoration stays at least +0.97 and rises to +1.53 for approximately 1201 years, indicating a sustained rather than transient shift coincident with LN → OBA. The opposite Z-score movements do not depend on score-direction interpretation, although the diversity-collapse and diversity-increase labels do.
